summary: Route native inbox dismiss, restore and snooze through shared optimistic mutations with receipt-fenced Undo. Small-action refusals restore the alert with a visible note; bounded-page omission never proves native control application.

replay.detail: Same-key transport retries preserve the exact prepared request, including semantic source revision and control CAS. Undo submits a fresh action key.

schema.detail: Uses existing generated attention control actions and presentation metadata.

rules.detail: Native controls change presentation only and never answer waiting work.

compatibility.detail: Alerts without native control metadata refuse honestly. Existing minimal prompt callers, structured Dismiss and message-read actions remain supported.

recovery.detail: Revert the web adapter change; accepted controls remain server-owned presentation state.
